verdicts.reason: A stays faithful to the original and has no collisions. Its flaws: the headline wraps and leaves the single word "Yet" alone on the second line, the content is crammed into the top half above a large empty area, the legal text is tiny, and the logo is small. B wraps the headline more neatly, but the orange divider cuts through "Small-Batch Blend", which is a clear collision. B also leaves a big empty gap between the headline and the body copy, jams the body copy against the CTA, and shrinks the eyebrow line and logo until they are hard to read.
